items.title: OpenAI Debuts New ChatGPT Payment Method With Card Networks
items.summary: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Wallet, a new secure payment method that its artificial intelligence tool can use to make purchases on consumers’ behalf, renewing its push into AI shopping after winding down an Instant Checkout feature earlier this year.
